originalEntry.title: Showreel tied to a designer's portfolio
originalEntry.title_zh: 呼应个人作品集的动效短片
originalEntry.author: monokern
originalEntry.description: A 15-second motion and sound design showreel conceptually tied to the author's portfolio, made in a Claude Code cloud session with access to the portfolio repo.
originalEntry.description_zh: 和作者个人作品集概念呼应的 15 秒动效短片，含声音设计，在 Claude Code 云端会话里读作品集仓库完成。
originalEntry.prompt: make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out. make it conceptually connected to my portfolio at http://monokern.design
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段 15 秒的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，就像简历里的作品集一样。拿出全部本事。让它在概念上和我在 http://monokern.design 的作品集呼应
originalEntry.note: Author: about $13 and about 1 hour from prompt to final MP4, including about 20 minutes of rendering.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称花费约 13 美元，从提示词到最终 MP4 约 1 小时，其中渲染约 20 分钟。
